newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that around 1,000 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Tuesday.
Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 700 steer calves were sold, although not enough to establish quote prices.
"Around 90 percent of cattle crossed previously contracted or sold on video," USDA said.
Through Del Rio, Texas, around 300 head were sold, but again not enough to establish market trend prices.
